core_insight.text: Indore families want their wedding-season sarees fresh, but they won't hand a costly or family saree to a shop they can't see inside, because one bad dry clean can't be undone.

concepts.title: Saree ka safar
concepts.logline: A worried customer's silk saree goes through every careful step at Shubh's counter and comes back folded in tissue, so she never has to wonder what happens inside.

insight.text: People trust what they can see: showing the inside of the shop answers "safe hai na?" better than any promise.
